scope: REQ-034 through REQ-040: official autonomous learning, configurable education sources, immutable teaching versions, nine activities/evidence, encrypted Android outbox, minimal parent authoring and v0.3.5 stable release
summary: V12 adds a write-before-send Android learning outbox encrypted with an Android Keystore AES/GCM key, explicit 401/409 recovery and a real one-lesson parent authoring flow. REQ-040 publishes these Stage 20/21 engineering capabilities as v0.3.5/versionCode 11 through the stable-signing tag workflow. The public APK digest, downloaded SHA-256, package, version and certificate match. Real AndroidKeyStore, process kill, network loss, public-site, overlay update/data retention and tablet accessibility/E2E still require a target device and reachable service, so Stage 21 remains BLOCKED rather than complete.

checks.result: H2 full regression exit 0: 21 domain, 2 infrastructure and 23 Boot tests; six PostgreSQL-only tests were conditionally skipped. Stage21TeachingModelsTest proves all nine activity types have explicit non-MASTERED requirements and rejects invalid answer-key payloads.

Stage21TeachingApiTest creates and replays a nested draft, publishes it, creates a separate V2 draft, assigns one lesson, hides answer keys from the child, records all nine activity types, rejects incomplete evidence, enforces rework freshness and parent confirmation, and validates idempotent replays. The targeted API test and the H2 full regression exited 0.

V12 tests cover deterministic queue encoding/reconstruction, original idempotency-key retention, payload dedupe, 100-item fail-closed limit, retryable versus review state, version refresh/already-achieved conflict reconciliation, HTTP failure classification, parent-token authoring and version-detail-before-assignment sequencing.
